newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Citibank says will not bid for Hungary's Mezobank.
newsitem.headline: Citibank says will not bid for Hungary's Mezobank.

text.p: Citibank Rt, wholly-owned unit of Citibank Overseas Investment Corp, said on Wednesday it had turned down an invitation by Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt to bid for Mezobank Rt.
"Citibank does not wish to participate in the tender for Mezobank's privatisation," the company said in a statement.
APV said on Tuesday it had sent invitations to tender to three foreign banks, Austria's GiroCredit and Raiffeisen Unicbank and Citibank.
Hungary plans to sell a 83.66 percent stake in Mezobank, a medium-sized bank, in a one-round private tender. The three banks have 60 days for a due diligence.
The purchase price will be a primary factor in assessing the offers, followed by the size of the capital increase and the quality of the business plan, APV said.
